requirements.title: Preserve this entire specification before substantial work
Establish repository reality before changing it
Provider and model availability is operator authority
Claims and fencing prevent duplicate work
Child lifecycle is separate from supervisor lifecycle
Runner owns execution lifecycle and waiting
Context Firewall is mandatory on the return path
Gearbox must respect authorization and policy
Gearbox may choose supervisor-local reasoning, but carefully
Deterministic work should avoid model delegation
Child prompts are fresh and bounded
The human may interrupt dormant supervision

requirements.justification: The specification explicitly defers scheduling. V0.1 uses event-driven child completion; no time-based scheduler is necessary for the proven vertical slice.
requirements.title: Scheduler is deferred

requirements.justification: The specification explicitly defers ephemeral isolated workers. V0.1 uses the replaceable local Runner boundary and ordinary OS processes.
requirements.title: Ephemeral workers are deferred
Self-hosting child work must be meaningful
Review can later be enabled without redesign
Child policy history is immutable evidence
Acceptance criteria travel with the task
Corrective work follows the same pipeline
Keep README distinct from implementation authority
Do not ask the human to become the message bus again
Supervisor should not consume all raw verification output
Decision log should be durable and concise
Mid-child policy changes apply prospectively unless explicitly required otherwise
Child completion is not proof of correctness
Compact result packets should have completeness state
Self-hosting cutover must be durably recorded
Bootstrap work is allowed before cutover, but must be minimized

requirements.justification: Bootstrap cutover succeeded and is durably evidenced, so the conditional cutover-failure reporting path was not triggered.
requirements.title: Cutover failure must be visible
Do not let V0.1 become a web application
Do not optimize prematurely for all AI providers
What is explicitly NOT required for V0.1
